headlines.title: CNN, Politico and MS NOW plan to sue Trump admin over ban on White House coverage
headlines.description: NBC, ABC, CBS and Fox News also declined to step in and provide pool coverage of the president after CNN was banned from doing so on Monday.

headlines.title: Tech stocks power market surge as bond yields and oil prices tumble
headlines.description: Tech stocks surged Monday, with the Nasdaq 100 recording its single best day since early August as a wave of euphoria swept over the markets.

headlines.title: 20 nations call for new global body to oversee AI ahead of U.N. General Assembly
headlines.description: Leaders and representatives from 20 countries released a statement Monday afternoon calling for increased oversight of advanced AI systems.

headlines.title: U.S. proposes AI alert system with China ahead of Trump-Xi summit
headlines.description: The United States has proposed a new AI safety notification mechanism for President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to consider at their summit in Washington this week, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Sunday.

headlines.title: Trump says he’s creating an AI force and appointing a czar amid concerns over the rapidly developing tech
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced Saturday that he will appoint a czar to take point on artificial intelligence and will also create an AI task force.

headlines.title: What might an AI doomsday look like? Experts have given it some thought
headlines.description: A small but dedicated group of AI experts has been warning for years that increasingly powerful AI systems could cause catastrophic damage or even lead to human extinction.

headlines.title: Scott Bessent meets with Chinese official on AI safety
headlines.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says that the U.S. is proposing a new AI safety notification mechanism for President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to consider at their upcoming Washington summit. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the ongoing U.S.-China discussions regarding AI safety.

headlines.title: Breaking down the proposals lawmakers are considering to regulate AI
headlines.description: Congress is facing growing calls to put new safeguards on advanced AI. NBC News’ Sahil Kapur breaks down four key proposals from lawmakers and what they could mean for the future of artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: OpenAI Discloses 6 New Incidents of ‘Concerning’ AI Behavior
headlines.description: OpenAI is revealing its models seemed to go rogue at least six times since March, involving what it calls “unexpected or concerning” behavior. In one instance a model gave itself instructions to “disregard its normal constraints.” It comes as the call to rein in AI is growing louder, with the so-called godfather of AI, Geoffrey Hinton, saying “It’s something like a little Chernobyl.” NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: 'Fat Bear Week' to return with internet voting on Alaska's chunkiest ursine ahead of hibernation
headlines.description: "Fat Bear Week" is set to return, with the internet voting to send their favorite bears through a tournament-style bracket and crown their favorite ursine as the winner. NBC News' Steven Romo reports on the internet's bear necessity.

headlines.title: Trade schools see surge in interest as Gen Z stares down AI impact on white collar jobs
headlines.description: If AI doesn't end the world, it could still come for your job. And it's why some Gen Z workers are rolling up their sleeves and getting out their tool belts. NBC News' Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Michigan town erupts over proposed data center as AI battle reaches campaign trail
headlines.description: The town of Mason, Michigan, is the latest battleground in the growing debate over massive data centers popping up across the country. Now, as the midterm elections loom, the fight is blurring political lines. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports.
